description: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli (NIT Trichy) is a public technical and research university near the city of Tiruchirappalli in Tamil Nadu, India. Founded in 1964, it is one of India's oldest technical universities.
The IISR, formerly known as Embassy of India School, Riyadh is an English-medium Indian school located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. It is one of the largest Indian schools with close to 9500 students.
